fixes.explanation: Tribute? Friend, I don't see any payment plan in this verse. The text says Caleb "…drove out from there the three sons of Anak…" and that's all it says about it. No deal is mentioned, just the three sons of Anak being driven out. I once hid in a drawer for years and never once paid rent, so I'm no expert on tribute (Joshua 15:14).

A treaty? Ooh, that's a very polite guess, baker. Very civilized. Pens out, clean desk, everybody shaking hands. But there's no treaty in this verse. It says Caleb "…drove out from there the three sons of Anak…" and they're the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. Nothing gets signed, they get driven out (Joshua 15:14).

problems.problem: The text does not say whether Caleb negotiated or brought paperwork or a wallet. The explanation presents those details as part of the event.
The joke mentions tea, a non-cookie food or drink not present in the passage.
The verse describes the people driven out as descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai; it does not explicitly name the three as those men.
